meta.name: Recall-32
meta.auxiliarySupervision: Layer 1 head 1 is supervised to attend from each animal to its colour; layer 2 head 1 is supervised to attend from the query to the correct animal. A training-only colour probe aligns first-block animal and query representations. Objective: colour-probe cross-entropy + answer cross-entropy + 0.15 language-model cross-entropy + 0.5 times each attention loss. This is a guided teaching model, not an emergent-circuit claim.
meta.training: Synthetic key-value recall; 2–4 unique colour/animal bindings. Fresh random validation: 1024 examples per length.
